entries.title: Proverbs 22:1
segments: A [good] name is rather to be chosen than great riches, [And] loving favor rather than silver and gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:2
segments: The rich and the poor meet together: Jehovah is the maker of them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:3
segments: A prudent man seeth the evil, and hideth himself; But the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:4
segments: The reward of humility [and] the fear of Jehovah [Is] riches, and honor, and life.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:5
segments: Thorns [and] snares are in the way of the perverse: He that keepeth his soul shall be far from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:6
segments: Train up a child in the way he should go, And even when he is old he will not depart from it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:7
segments: The rich ruleth over the poor; And the borrower is servant to the lender.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:8
segments: He that soweth iniquity shall reap calamity; And the rod of his wrath shall fail.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:9
segments: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; For he giveth of his bread to the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:10
segments: Cast out the scoffer, and contention will go out; Yea, strife and ignominy will cease.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:11
segments: He that loveth pureness of heart, [For] the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:12
segments: The eyes of Jehovah preserve [him that hath] knowledge; But he overthroweth the words of the treacherous man.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:13
segments: The sluggard saith, There is a lion without: I shall be slain in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:14
segments: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: He that is abhorred of Jehovah shall fall therein.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:15
segments: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child; [But] the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:16
segments: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his [gain], [And] he that giveth to the rich, [shall come] only to want.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:17
segments: Incline thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, And apply thy heart unto my knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:18
segments: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee, If they be established together upon thy lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:19
segments: That thy trust may be in Jehovah, I have made [them] known to thee this day, even to thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:20
segments: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:21
segments: To make thee know the certainty of the words of truth, That thou mayest carry back words of truth to them that send thee?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:22
segments: Rob not the poor, because he is poor; Neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

entries.title: Proverbs 22:23
segments: For Jehovah will plead their cause, And despoil of life those that despoil them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:24
segments: Make no friendship with a man that is given to anger; And with a wrathful man thou shalt not go:

entries.title: Proverbs 22:25
segments: Lest thou learn this ways, And get a snare to thy soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:26
segments: Be thou not one of them that strike hands, [Or] of them that are sureties for debts.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:27
segments: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:28
segments: Remove not the ancient landmark, Which thy fathers have set.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:29
segments: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
